messages.subject: CXXR's DataFrame
parts:
Hi CXXR Experts,

I have been programming R for many years now and I have been making my way into C++ and other languages. I am very interested in the internals of R and CXXR especially the data frame which is essentially emulating dynamic behaviour since it is able to create columns composed of character, numeric, logical, and factor types binding them together without having to specify the type of the data frame.

Usually a heterogeneous structure of this kind would have to specify the type of the container (data frame) before it could be created. I am interested in creating a simple version of this type of structure in C++ and wandered if someone could explain how it works. I know that it has something to do with sexpressions which represent some parent type that the data frame can be composed of.

Thanks in advance

DP
